text: Bought a skateboard at Zumiez, then went back for the rest of my stuff. At first it felt good. My friend, his little brother, and I sat with a lady who introduced herself as a manager. She said she'd been putting boards together every day she worked there, and that on her bad days she'd snapped at customers. I thought it would be quick. Fifteen minutes, at most. But it took ninety. She ruined two bolts, then swapped them for ones that looked like they might be sold to someone else. She finally got her brother and another guy - another manager apparently - to help finish it off. No apology. They've lost our future business. It really broke my heart.
